title: Unify the Night context hero
summary: Night now opens with one composed context hero that combines hospital identity, screen title, shared shift identity and selected-night navigation.
changes: Night now treats the Mater Dei utility strip, Night title, shared shift identity and selected date as one unified top hero rather than separate floating sections.
The shared shift artwork and name remain the personality anchor inside the hero, with room for the tagline to wrap naturally.
Previous and next night controls are embedded directly into the full-width date navigator instead of floating separately at the edges of the screen.
Staffing remains available as a small subordinate chip so it never competes with the date, while Your night begins immediately below the unified hero.
